chunks: Then on that day you will surely be asked about the verity of pleasures.

key_terms.النَّعِيمِ: The blessings/pleasures (referring to worldly favors and gifts from God)
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What will humans be asked about regarding their worldly blessings on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Takathur underscores the concept of 'Hisab al-Ni'am' (Accounting of Blessings), where every favor, whether great or small, is scrutinized for its proper utilization. Scholars emphasize that this accountability extends beyond mere possession to the gratitude and purposeful use of these trusts, reflecting the divine justice that evaluates human stewardship. This serves as a profound reminder that worldly pleasures are transient tests rather than ultimate goals.
